name.ja: 計測: ゲームの「〜の最中」の旗

description.en: Records who sets and clears the seven in_* flags (battle, boss battle, colosseum battle, conversation, free input, action in conversation, shopping), which game functions read them, their values after a load and before a save, and changes that bypass the attribute. Read-only
description.ja: 7つの in_ 旗（戦闘・ボス戦・闘技場の試合・会話・自由入力・会話中の行動・売買）を誰が立てて誰が下ろすか、ゲームのどの関数が読むか、ロード後と保存前の値、属性を通らない書き換えを録る。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない
